description: Triggers for setting up CI quality gates, branch protection and environment approvals that enforce the Agentic SDLC sign-offs, proving gates block bad changes, rehearsing rollbacks and deciding advance/hold/roll back during a staged rollout

queries.query: Set up GitHub Actions so our Definition of Done runs on every PR and blocks the merge
Configure branch protection and CODEOWNERS so spec approvals are actually enforced
Add a production environment that needs the release owner's approval before deploying
Prove our CI gates really block a bad change before we claim enforcement
Rehearse the rollback in staging for this release and time it
Stage 1 has been live 30 minutes, should we advance to 10%, hold or roll back?
Pick canary or blue-green for this rollout and set the thresholds
Port the agentic-sdlc gates to our GitLab pipeline with merge request approvals
Our coverage floor isn't enforced in CI, wire it into the pipeline
Write the release notes and ask the release owner for sign-off
Set up AGENTS.md and record our lint and test commands for the project
Run the Definition of Done and show me evidence before I mark this task done
Production is throwing 500s after the deploy, triage the incident
Write the spec with acceptance criteria and a rollback command for the CSV export
Add secret scanning and dependency audit to the threat model for this change
Review this pull request for correctness and security issues
